dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**DAY 1 ROUNDUP: POWER HITTERS DOMINATE THE DAY**

Dillon Dingler led the Detroit Tigers to a 1-4 victory over the Chicago White Sox, hitting his 17th home run of the season. In the nightcap, Manny Machado's 5-RBI performance propelled the San Diego Padres to a 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers. Meanwhile, Kyle Schwarber's three-home run, six-RBI day helped the Philadelphia Phillies crush the New York Mets 15-3.

On the mound, Joey Cantillo tossed a complete-game shutout, striking out nine, as the Cleveland Guardians defeated the Houston Astros 8-1. Paul Skenes pitched six strong innings, fanning eight, but took the loss as the Colorado Rockies edged the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-1.
